verdict.rationale: Manufact documents API keys for programmatic access, but the evidence describes them only as authenticating access to the whole organization. Nothing shows scoping, per-resource permissions, or least-privilege restrictions for an agent's credentials, so the documented capability is adjacent rather than the story itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API keys authenticate programmatic access to your organization, from the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts.
